decisions.question: Scope split: how should the three threads in this issue (escalation tuning, auto-issue filing, host→overseer migration) be packaged?

options.label: Option B (recommended) — one pipeline for escalation tuning + auto-issue filing; host migration as a follow-up issue
Option A — single pipeline covering all three threads
Option C — three separate pipelines, one per thread
Option D — narrow this pipeline to auto-issue filing only; both other threads become follow-ups
Other (explain in reply)

decisions.question: Sub-agent launching by the overseer (the speculative capability in the issue body): in scope for this pipeline or deferred?

options.label: Deferred — file a follow-up issue, out of scope here
In scope — design a sub-agent-launch capability in this pipeline
Other (explain in reply)

decisions.question: Should this pipeline also address related overseer bugs (#1722 stale AGENT_FAILED misdiagnosis, #1727 early-exit respawn), or leave them to their own pipelines?

options.label: Leave them in their own pipelines — link as context only
Absorb #1722 into this pipeline (it is a p1 false-positive case)
Absorb both #1722 and #1727 into this pipeline
Absorb only #1727
Other (explain in reply)

decisions.question: Auto-issue filing policy: what qualifies for the overseer to auto-file a GitHub issue?

options.label: Persistent / systemic only — same anomaly across N cycles AND clear orchestrator/agent-code bug signals
All priority=high OVERSEER_ALERTs with dedup on anomaly type within pipeline
Sonnet-gated per-anomaly rubric — LLM decides case-by-case
Hybrid — systemic criteria as the floor, Sonnet gate above it
Other (explain in reply)

decisions.question: Auto-issue dedup scope: when the overseer considers filing, what window should it search to avoid duplicates?

options.label: Per pipeline — dedup only against this pipeline's prior filings
Per repo — search all open overseer-filed issues across the repo by anomaly label
Global — search across all open issues, including human-filed ones, by label + title fuzzy match
No dedup — file every time; accept some duplication risk
Other (explain in reply)

decisions.question: Dedup state storage: where does the overseer remember issues it has already filed?

options.label: In-process only — each phase's overseer starts fresh; rely on GitHub search each time
Persisted to .egg-state/oversight/filed-issues.json so respawns/new phases remember
Persisted via orchestrator REST endpoint (central store); overseer asks 'have I filed this?' before filing
Hybrid — persist locally AND verify via GitHub search before filing
Other (explain in reply)

decisions.question: Label convention for overseer-filed issues: which label set should we standardize on?

options.label: Use existing dead-code convention: `egg:diagnostic` + `pipeline-health` + anomaly-type label
Use docs convention: `overseer-alert` + category label (e.g., `stall`, `repeated-error`)
Use pre-refine-notes convention: `overseer-opened` + anomaly-type label + pipeline-id link in body
New naming — propose in 'Other' (explain in reply)
Other (explain in reply)

decisions.question: Issue body template: keep the existing `## Pipeline Diagnostic: ...` template at orchestrator/overseer/issue_filer.py:86-107, or redesign?

options.label: Keep existing template (pipeline + phase + agent + timeline + classification + actions + logs + remediation)
Extend the existing template with explicit links (pipeline ID, phase, branch, commit SHA, parent-alert message ID)
Redesign — draft a new template in the plan phase
Other (explain in reply)

decisions.question: Who actually runs `gh issue create` for an overseer-filed issue?

options.label: Agent-side overseer runs it in its sandbox via a new `egg-orch overseer file-issue` CLI verb
Orchestrator-side — new REST endpoint; server runs `gh` with its own credentials; overseer POSTs payload
Hybrid — overseer composes body, orchestrator files it; orchestrator enforces central rate-limit / dedup policy
Reuse the existing dead-code `file_diagnostic_issue` path by instantiating OverseerMonitor in production
Other (explain in reply)

decisions.question: Rollout mode for auto-issue filing: should it start in shadow mode or go live directly?

options.label: Shadow mode first — overseer composes issue body but raises a HITL decision 'should I file this?'; human approves; flip to live after a trial period
Live directly — ship with dedup + per-pipeline cap; iterate on policy via actual issues filed
Feature flag — ship live but gated by config `overseer_auto_file_issues` (default off) for a release
Other (explain in reply)

decisions.question: Defer the host→overseer migration (thread 3) to a follow-up issue (confirming Option B recommendation)?

options.label: Yes — file a follow-up issue; keep this pipeline scoped to escalation tuning + auto-issue filing
No — migrate host logic in this pipeline
Partial — migrate only stall/NACK detection; leave long-running-phase + stuck-pipeline-rescue with /sdlc
Other (explain in reply)

decisions.question: /sdlc wall-clock thresholds (3 min stall, 10 min silent agent, 60 min long-running phase): when / if they migrate to the overseer, should the thresholds change?

options.label: Keep identical — same numeric thresholds, just moved across the process boundary
Make configurable per-pipeline via PipelineConfig (default to current values)
Revise numbers as part of migration — human to specify in plan phase
Defer until the migration pipeline
Other (explain in reply)
Proceed independently — let #1806 adapt to whatever auto-issue policy lands here
Coordinate — resolve the overlap question in #1806 first (or as a blocking decision) before finalizing auto-issue scope
Absorb part of #1806 into this pipeline — pick a consolidation stance now
Other (explain in reply)

decisions.question: Coordination with #1786 (per-role PATH restriction): should this pipeline also bake in overseer PATH restrictions for any new CLI verb (`egg-orch overseer file-issue`)?

options.label: No — wait for #1786 to ship on its own; use server-side gateway enforcement only
Yes — pre-allocate a role-specific PATH entry as part of this pipeline
Add a gateway allowlist rule now, defer PATH restructuring to #1786
Other (explain in reply)

decisions.question: Coordination with #1902 (overseer file-boundary policy): should this pipeline expand `OVERSEER_PATTERNS` to allow writes under `.egg-state/oversight/` for filed-issue dedup state?

options.label: Yes — expand OVERSEER_PATTERNS allowlist to include the chosen dedup state file
No — use an orchestrator-side store instead; overseer never writes dedup state locally
Defer — decide during plan phase based on the chosen dedup-storage option (decision-6)
Other (explain in reply)

decisions.question: If host→overseer migration is in scope (decision-11 = No or Partial), where does the cross-cycle agent-timing state live (currently /sdlc's in-memory map of {role: {phase, phase_entered_at, nudged_at, first_seen_at, has_any_messages}})?

options.label: In the overseer only — phase-scoped, lost on phase transition / overseer respawn
In the orchestrator's health_monitor — persistent across phases / respawns
In `.egg-state/oversight/agent-timing.json` — persistent, phase-scoped, overseer-owned
N/A — thread 3 deferred per decision-11
Other (explain in reply)
